notes.title: Castle Warriors Road Map #1
notes.content:
[b]Hello Warriors!
[/b]
We have a lot of exciting things to talk about for the future of Castle Warriors. We are hoping to add a lot with our end of year patch and wanted to give you guys an idea of what to expect.  As you guys know we are a small two-man team but we have both recently taken on the challenge of being full time on this project for the remainder of the year. Our goal is to make this next patch something truly special. The major thing is we have been delaying system rewrites for a while now but we are finally committing to them. What that means is we wont be able to patch the game while we do these rewrites. However, there are lots of major things coming with this patch. Here is what we have planned currently:

Patch 0.6 Goal - Mid November

- Overall system rewrites that will solve all lag issues. Combat Flow as well as unit pathing will be seeing massive changes. With these change we are hoping to increase the gameplay speed and number of units on screen dramatically.
- Massive unit balance overhaul to all units via new abilities and attacks
- In game Tooltips for everything. Unit stats, ability details, upgrade details, warrior details, etc. 
- Endless Mode - Featuring a new game format and new enemies!
- Map 7 - Featuring a new faction of enemies!
- +6 Maps adding a new Difficulty Modifier
- 1 New Player Faction
- 1 New Warrior
- New Unit Sprites for all Player Factions

This is a big patch for us because we are hoping it will be closer to what we envisioned when we first started this journey. We are commited to making this next patch the biggest and best patch Castle Warriors has seen yet. While we are behind the scenes working on this patch we do plan to release DevLogs to keep you guys up to date on our progress. 

Thank you for all of your support so far this year! Hopefully, we end the year with a bang :slight_smile:

notes.title: Major Patch 4
notes.content:
[b]Hey Warriors[/b]
We are hyped to push our fourth Major Patch! As always we appreciate your patience, and we'll continue to post announcements on our future plans in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b].

[previewyoutube=AxIS9AguW9s;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Early Access 0.5.0[/b]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]First pass of Unit SFX for basic attacks and (non-Warrior) explosions
[*]Reworked Achievements to Quests and Early Progression (removed existing T3/T4 units unlocks until new Quests are completed)
[*]Reworked Talents and reset all Talent Points
[*]First pass of Lifetime Stats
[*]New look for all Dragons
[*]Added tracking fastest Clear Time for all +5 Maps
[*]Changed Map 3 to Map 6 and pushed former Maps 4-6 down to 3-5
[*]Added a Map loading system to reduce game size on disk
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Enemy Vassal showing green HP bar 
[*]Fixed Elf Warrior DOT doing too much damage
[*]Fixed Elf Warrior duration lasting too long
[*]Fixed some Warriors not tracking kills in specific situations
[*]Still testing bandaid fixes for Orc Warrior as we setup to rework in 0.6.0, sorry!
[*]Fixed Enraged Lizard Wizard dying after attacking once
[*]Fixed Reroll button showing on the first Artifact Selection
[/list]
[b]Map Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed the Enemy Castle to stop regenning HP if any of the T3 Towers are down (previously required all T3 Towers down)
[*]Minor adjustment to Player and Enemy spawn positions
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]General QOL to most places
[*]New End Round screen
[*]Added pressing the Escape key on Main Menu to close menus or open the Options
[*]Changed some UI sounds and added them to a few missing places
[/list]

You can always find the patch notes and other announcements in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b]

Thanks!
Kall and darbs

notes.title: Early Access 0.4.5
notes.content:
[b]Hey Warriors![/b]
A large amount of changes (close to a Major patch) in this one; please let us know what you think!

[i]Sorry we haven't posted the patch notes for 0.4.2 through 0.4.4 on Steam, but you can always find the patch notes in [b][url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]our Discord[/url][/b].[/i]

[b]Early Access 0.4.5[/b]

[b]Major Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Reworked Dwarf Warrior: will now randomly pick one of three banners, adding Thorns, Attack Damage, or Attack Damage reduction to nearby Player Units
[*]Reworked all 36 maps -- hoping the rounds feel more dynamic
[*]Swapped Difficulty Scaling Enemy modifiers: enraged Bosses now start appearing on +1 and enraged Units on +2
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Hopefully fixed the soft lock during Card Shop/Boss Reward/Artifact
[*]Fixed a bunch of Unit sizes -- hopefully stops Units from pushing each other around
[*]Fixed oversized death animations on many Units
[*]Fixed Lizard Wizard instant dying
[*]Fixed Air Elemental not unlocking when beating map 2 
[*]Added handling for unlocking Air Elemental if Player has beaten map 2 and doesn't have it unlocked
[*]Fixed Player castle not being damaged by Enemy Explosions
[*]Fixed Lancer being default unlocked 
[*]Fixed Demon Prince base/+ Ability
[*]Fixed Pit Fiend+ Ability
[*]Fixed Warlock base and + Ability
[*]Fixed Player Units not getting increased Lifesteal healing from healing Talent
[*]Fixed Battering Ram + Grunt from doing Bonus Damage to bosses. They now correctly do Bonus Damage to structures.
[*]Fixed Fire Dragon base/+ and Paladin base/+ UI hitbox
[*]Fixed Map 4 purple Snake Boss hit box and attack range
[*]Fixed certain Enemies not being able to charge
[*]Fixed certain Enemy enraged and flood mobs not being Polymorph'd
[*]Fixed Summoner Warrior not tracking kills for end round stats
[*]Fixed level scaling Warriors seeing the kill scaling artifact
[*]Fixed bug that might have made the Warrior artifacts slightly more chance to be rng'd on 2nd/3rd screen 
[*]Fixed Thorns returning damage to structures
[*]Fixed Talent buy button being clickable after swapping tabs
[*]Fixed Super Nuke not hitting enemies near the Player castle
[/list]
[b]Talents[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered Offense Talent "Warrior Stacking Flat" bonus from +2 to +1
[*]Lowered the cost for some Utility Talents
   Tower 1    1p to 0p
   Tower 2   3p to 1p 
   Reroll 1    3p to 1p
   Nuke 1     3p to 1p
[/list]
[b]Player Units[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered Alchemist base/+ Ability Cooldown
[*]Lowered Rogue base/+ Attack Damage
[*]Lowered Water Elemental base/+ Bonus Damage
[*]Increased Water Elemental base/+ Attack Damage
[*]Increased Phoenix base/+ Ability Damage 
[*]Increased Demidog base/+ Explosion Damage 
[*]Increased Worg Rider base/+ Attack Damage
[*]Changed Air Elemental base/+ Bonus Damage type to Boss -- testing them as boss busters
[*]Changed Blunderbusser base/+ Bonus Damage type to Boss -- testing them as boss busters
[*]Increased Blunderbusser base/+ Bonus Damage
[*]Changed Tree Ent base/+ Bonus Damage type to Boss -- testing them as boss busters
[*]Changed Tree Ent base/+ to Single Target
[*]Increased Tree Ent base/+ Bonus Damage
[/list]
[b]Enemy Units[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered XP that Enemy enraged Units give from 16 to 12 per mob -- Players were getting a higher level than we intended on higher difficulties 
[*]Changed all bosses to attack both Ground and Air Units
[*]Increased Boss Explosion Damage from 300 to 600
[/list]
[b]Warriors[/b]
[list]
[*]Lowered base Elf Warrior damage from 25 to 15
[*]Increased Cooldown for all Warriors -- testing cooldown increase instead of a power decrease
[*]Increased Demon Warrior Meteor damage
[/list]
[b]Artifacts[/b]
[list]
[*]Combined the Faction-specific Artifacts
[*]Added a Thorns artifact that adds 30% Thorns to all Player Melee Units
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*]Changed some of the Tavern UI 
[*]Added Artifacts to the Tavern that are viewable after Player unlocks Difficulty Scaling
[*]Added Faction colors for the Faction Artifacts
[*]Added Faction colors on the Player Army List
[*]Added hint text during Boss Rewards to skip by pressing spacebar
[*]Updated some of the Artifact pictures
[/list]

Thanks!
Kall and darbs

notes.title: Major Patch 3 Update
notes.content:
Hello Warriors,

As we are approaching the release of patch 0.4 we wanted to update you guys on what features and changes to expect in this patch. We are still about 2 weeks away from the patch dropping but you will be playing the patch this month! There are a few key things we wanted to go over with this patch as there are quite a few big changes to the game.

First things first, [b]WE WILL BE WIPING SAVED DATA WITH THIS PATCH[/b]. We do not do this lightly and were trying to avoid this but we think its best for a lot of reasons. The early game is getting a massive overhaul on how you unlock units, warriors, and things like towers. Instead of unlocking units or warriors with gold they are now unlocked via achievements. In our previous versions it would take 10+ hours of gameplay to fully unlock all the units. This process has been streamlined down to a few hours max now. When you clear the 6 maps on their base difficulty you will have unlocked the full unit roster now. These system rewrites have made it very difficult for some save files to transition to the new patch without lots of bugs and errors.

The second reason for the wipe is the new talent system. The Talent system has been set up in a way that when you clear a map for the first time you get +1 talent point. With how we set up this system it was also interacting poorly with our old saves. Players who had cleared most of the maps or partial clears were going to be forced to go back and individually clear maps they already cleared to reclaim those talent points. As with the above system changes this was also leading to frustrating gameplay experiences with the new patch.

Addressing all the problems with save data and the current patch would have caused far too many delays. Add on the fact that we really want you guys to test out the new early game systems, a wipe seems like the best option for us. We aren't happy about this and will be doing everything we can to avoid save wipes in the future. The new early game is way smoother to get through now though, and we hope you won't find it as tedious as your first play through.

With that out of the way here is what to expect from this patch!

Talents - Clear a map for the first time and get +1 talent point with currently 36 talent points total in the game. These talents can be placed into Offensive, Defensive, or Utility trees. You are able to reset your talents at any time to try out multiple builds and styles. As we add more maps and difficulty levels the total amount of talent points in the game will increase over time.

Early Game Overhaul - Unlocking Units is now done by clearing maps. You will unlock the first half of a faction by surviving 10 minutes on a map and the second half of the faction by clearing the map. By the time you have cleared all 6 base maps you will have access to the full 50 unit roster and a handful of warriors. Once map 6 has been cleared you will gain access to Artifacts and Difficulty scaling.

Artifact rework - Artifacts have gotten major changes in this patch. We have fully removed the generic artifacts that buff all units by a percentage. We have added faction based artifacts and warrior artifacts that drastically change how the warrior ability works. We have also reworked both the dwarf and elf warrior abilities so make sure the check them out!

Patch will also feature a change to map sizes, +5 difficulty maps, and some unit balance changes.

We greatly appreciate all the support you guys have given us over the last several months. The game has seriously changed quite a bit since launch and its because of your feedback. Please continue giving us your feedback, bug reports, and support because it's fueling us hard! Drop a steam review if you haven't as its the best way to support us currently! We will have the exact date for the release of this patch soon but expect it before the end of the month for sure!

notes.title: Major Patch 1
notes.content:
Hey Warriors! 

We would like to start our first Major Patch notes by saying thank you to everyone! All of your screenshots, bug reports, balance feedback, and general discussion both on the Steam Forums and in our Discord means a lot to both of us. Another big thank you to the content creators we've seen put out Castle Warriors videos and streams! 

This first Major Patch is our tightest window with only around two weeks of development time, but every following Major Patch has a full month scheduled. We're looking forward to the next few months of Early Access and hope to hear more from you all!

[h3][b]Major 0.2.0[/b][/h3]
[i]this version number should show in the bottom left of your Main Menu[/i]

[b]Break Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]More small lag fixes as we rewrite some of our existing systems for the big lag fix
[*]Pretty sure we fixed all of the Orc Warrior bugs, but please let us know if you see one
[*]Fixed some Enemy units not taking damage from Damage over Time Abilities
[/list]
[b]Player Unit Changes[/b]
[list]
[u]All[/u]
[*]Added, updated, or fixed various Ability animations

[u]Elf[/u]
[*]Added Phoenix+ ability to Phoenix with reduced Ability Damage
[/list]
[b]Map Changes[/b]
[list]
[u]Map 3[/u]
[*]Reworked Map 3 +0 to be in line with other +0 maps

[u]Difficulty Scaled[/u]
[*]Reworked +1, +2, and +3 maps to be more difficult
[*]Enemy units will upgrade to a more powerful version after 4 minutes of spawning

[u]Bonus Map[/u]
[*]Added experimental Bonus Map that unlocks after purchasing all 50 units + 5 Faction Warriors
[*]The Artifact system has arrived to the Bonus Map, let us know what you think!
[/list]
[b]Warrior Changes[/b]
[list]
[u]Elf[/u]
[*]Buffed Warrior Ability size

[u]Neutral[/u]
[*]Added two Warriors that automatically unlock after beating Map 6
[/list]
[b]Upgrade Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted the Gold costs for Reroll 1-3
[*]Adjusted when Reroll 2 and Tower 2 unlock
[/list]
[b]UI Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Added Warrior information to Tavern
[*]Expanded the Options menu
[*]Fixed Volume Sliders not visually updating to saved settings on load
[*]Added SFX when changing volume sliders
[*]Fixed close button on ingame pause screen
[*]Fixed Warrior Ability cooldown indicator showing over the scaling text
[*]Added tooltip to the bottom right of the Card selection screen
[*]Added two diagrams to the Main Menu Help screen
[*]A lot of small tweaks that no one will notice
[/list]
[i][b]Planned for 0.2.1 or 0.2.2[/b][/i]
[i]-Restart Save
-Artifacts GUI [/i]


You can always find the patch notes earlier [url=https://discord.gg/BqZPffsfwE]in our Discord[/url]

[list]
[*] Unicorn - Major HP buff on base and + unit. Minor attack damage, attack speed, attack range buff on base and + unit
[*] Druid - Ability damage buff on base and + unit 
[*] Tree Ent - HP buff on base and + unit
[/list]
[u]Human[/u]
[list]
[*] Gryphon - HP buff on base and + unit 
[*] Wizard - Attack damage buff on base and + unit. Minor attack speed buff on base and + unit
[/list]
[u]Dwarf[/u]

[*] Brawler - Major HP buff on base and + unit
[*] Blunderbusser - Minor attack damage buff on base unit

[*] Priest - Attack speed nerfed on base and + unit
[*] King Thanagan - Attack range and attack damage buff on base and + unit
[/list]
[u]Orc[/u]
[list]
[*] Grunt - Major HP buff on base and + units
[*] Lightning Elemental - Ability damage buff on base and + unit
[*] Worg Rider - Major HP buff on base and + unit
[/list]
[u]Demon[/u]
[list]
[*] Imp - HP and attack damage buff on base and + unit
[*] Cultist - HP buff on base and + unit. 
[*] Pitfiend - HP buff on base unit
[*] Succubus - Ability damage buff on base and + unit
[/list]

[b]Map Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated some of the map 2 bosses to be more difficult
[*] Updated some of the map 3 bosses to more difficult
[*] Nerfed spawn rate of enemy Genie on difficulty scaling maps +1 - +3. AOE attack radius buff
[*] Fixed enemy Ice Dragon ability that wasn't casting
[*] Hopefully fixed the unkillable Ice Dragon Boss on map 6
[*] Fixed Map 6 +2 not spawning the end dino
[*] Fixed Map 6 +3 not spawning the end dino
[/list]

[b]Warrior Changes[/b]
[list]
[*] Minor ability damage buff on Elf Warrior Polymorph
[*] Minor ability damage buff on Orc Warrior
[*] Increased the speed that Demon Warrior's meteor falls down
[*] Decreased the Demon Warrior's delay between casting and the meteor falling down
[/list]

[*] Updated the Unit Descriptions for almost all base and + units
[*] Blocked clicking on the card shop for .5s after it pops up
[*] Fixed Army List button to be clickable during the card shop
[*] Fixed Unicorn+ basic attack not counting to overall unit damage
[*] Testing fullscreen and resolution options
[/list]
